scope: Whole report read; same-vendor saved ETF calculations and internal arithmetic verified. N-PORT, holdings reconstructions, company evidence, traditional-bank basket and HY regressions not independently reproduced.
new_information: Separates cumulative outperformance from daily co-movement. The 2.414pp return gap is modest relative to observed tracking volatility; unusual correlation need not imply unusually large outperformance.

Reported holdings counterfactual removes CM5 (JPM/BAC/GS/MS/C), leaving KBWB -6.62% versus KRE -6.02%; reported October rebound becomes 5.00% versus 5.06%. Useful composition hypothesis, subject to reconstruction audit.
Reported traditional-bank comparison maintains unusually low correlation while yield sensitivity matches KRE, narrowing rate sensitivity as an explanation of the separation.
Reported HY coefficients no longer significantly negative; new hypothesis about changed credit sensitivity, not proof of indifference or AI-specific credit widening.

verified_local_checks.basis: Simple adjusted daily returns; 63 returns Aug 4 to Oct 30, base close Aug 3; intercept/SPY regressions for residual correlation; each historical window fitted separately.
verified_local_checks.baseline_limit: Report 11.1% earlier versus 2.6% now; our saved history gives 10.37% versus 2.82%. Historical start materially affects rarity; both are descriptive, overlapping-window ranks.

issues.finding: Lens 1 components do not sum to the stated group
issues.detail: 1.04 + 0.78 - 0.37 = 1.45pp, not 1.81pp; 43% + 32% - 15% = 60%, not 75%. Including 0.60 residual yields 2.05pp, not 2.41pp. The ex-CM endpoint subtraction supports 1.81pp arithmetically, but individual contributions need correction or an explicit nonadditive method.
Holdings accounting identifies which securities contributed, not why prices changed or how long changes last. Report itself acknowledges durable repricing may explain GS/MS weakness.

issues.finding: Insignificant current HY coefficient is not proof of no exposure
issues.detail: t=0.9 and 1.3 permit substantial uncertainty. Need confidence intervals and direct tests of coefficient differences. Prior significance versus current nonsignificance does not establish a structural change. R2 KRE remains 0.16.

issues.finding: HY mirror and holdings provenance missing from supplied package
issues.detail: Earlier report lacked long HY history; this one uses an unnamed mirror. Require exact URL, vintage, raw series and validation. Endpoint N-PORT/holdings backdrift requires checks for membership/share-count changes; near-perfect ETF replication is helpful but not sufficient to certify all counterfactuals.

issues.finding: No quality sorting and funding mechanism claims are too categorical
issues.detail: Failure of selected Q2 metrics to explain current returns is not proof investors ignore fundamentals. Loan/deposit association loses significance when four banks excluded; descriptive channel only.

Rate-volatility half-attribution is not an identified causal decomposition; no measured term-premium decomposition supplied; Q3 deposit-cost changes cannot be assigned to a late-quarter September hike from chronology alone.

issues.finding: Event dummy attribution and significance need limits
issues.detail: Dummies isolate date-specific residuals, not identified causal effects. 0.40 volatility units is descriptive, not a formal significance test. Multiple hypotheses, windows and selected traits remain exploratory.

synthesis: Useful new composition evidence for the endpoint gap, plus a separate persistent co-movement question. Market-adjusted rarity is more baseline-sensitive than prior synthesis conveyed. No conclusion that regional-bank fundamentals improved, that credit risk vanished, or that the relative move must reverse.
next_bounded_evidence: Reconcile additive holdings attribution; supply weights/N-PORT and mirror time series; report comparable-bank and HY coefficients with uncertainty and fixed historical baselines. No new monitoring routine commissioned.
